gaps.acceptance: records.list|get|create|update|archive|restore exist behind the contract, validate against FieldDef, accept an idempotency key and require an audit reason; grid, forms and bulk actions all write through them.
registerViewKind(kind, renderer) plus one <ViewHost spec /> renders every kind; an unknown kind renders a placeholder with a 'not wired yet' toast instead of throwing.
/demo/<kind> exists for all eleven kinds over a seeded 100k-row dataset; a cold session can open any view without fixtures of its own.
autonumber, createdTime, lastModifiedTime, createdBy, lastModifiedBy are read-only computed field types present in Airtable, Baserow and NocoDB.
Any view exports honouring filters, sorts and visible fields; calendar views publish an ICS feed; large exports stream as a job.
Row and cell colour rules built from FilterTree conditions render in grid, kanban, calendar and gallery, and never rely on colour alone.

gaps.feature: Extra field types (richText, duration, time, progress, json)
gaps.acceptance: Each type has a cell, an editor, a cast and a documented conversion; matches Notion rich text, ClickUp progress and NocoDB JSON.
FieldDef.defaultValue with dynamic tokens and per-dataset record templates from the New record menu.
Search inside the current view, navigate matches, replace per type with a preview and a batched write.
Drag to fill down or across with copy, numeric series and date pattern detection, undoable as one entry.
Collab extends the anchor grammar with cell:<datasetRef>:<recordId>:<fieldId> and the grid renders an indicator; no tables issue owns it today.

gaps.feature: Cell-level presence in grids and boards
gaps.acceptance: Realtime projects awareness onto grid cells and kanban cards, not only pages and record streams.

gaps.feature: Voice and remote input for view actions
gaps.acceptance: Every view action carries an intent phrase and is reachable from a d-pad and from voice, per the org input standard.

gaps.feature: p95 budgets for views.query, views.groups and records.update
gaps.acceptance: The release-candidate smoke keeps the 100k-row numbers honest as field types and formulas land.
One ADR records barcode, QR, password field, regex filter, is_even_and_whole, mind map, native mobile app and cell comments as wontdo for v0.1, with the reason and the revisit trigger.
